title: Import files
intro: Bring over an existing file collection in a few steps: choose a ZIP archive (including Google Takeout) or a whole folder, define rules for tags, capture date and albums, check the preview and start.
othersImport: This import was prepared by {name}. You can view and cancel it, but not edit it.

source.title: Where do the files come from?
source.zipHint: One or more ZIP files, e.g. a download from OneDrive, Dropbox or Google Takeout (upload split archives one by one).
source.folderHint: Choose a folder on this device, e.g. a synced OneDrive or Google Drive folder. Only files you import are transferred.
source.cloudHint: No cloud service set up? Download the folder or create a Takeout export and upload it here.
source.limits: Per import at most 50,000 files and 100 GB; documents up to 20 MB, images up to 100 MB, ZIP archives up to 10 GB each. Only one import runs per club at a time.
source.uploadZipHint: Only the table of contents is read. For Google Takeout, upload all parts one after another; the «Takeout» folder is detected automatically.
source.uploadFolderHint: At first only the list of files is sent. Your browser uploads the files themselves after the start - keep this window open then.
source.dropZip: Drag ZIP files here or choose them.
source.dropFolder: Drag a folder here or choose it.
source.archiveAdded: {count, plural, one {Archive added.} other {# archives added.}}
source.listed: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} found ({size}, {archives, plural, =0 {folder} one {# archive} other {# archives}}).
source.cloudHintConnected: hocX only reads what you select from the cloud service and keeps the encrypted access only until the import ends.

providerHint.microsoft: Connect OneDrive personal, OneDrive for Business or SharePoint libraries directly. You choose the folders in hocX.
providerHint.dropbox: Connect your Dropbox directly and choose the folders in hocX.
providerHint.webdav: Connect Infomaniak kDrive, Nextcloud, SwissDisk or another WebDAV storage with an app password.
providerHint.google_drive: Pick individual files. Google Docs, Sheets and Slides are imported as Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Whole folders via Google Takeout.
providerHint.google_photos: Pick photos directly in Google Photos. Videos are not imported.

options.albumsEnabled: Put images into albums by rule
options.albumsHint: Off by default: images go to the gallery and can be added to an album later via multi-select.

cancel.label: Discard import
cancel.draftConfirm: Discard this import? Uploaded archives and the file list will be deleted.
cancel.runningConfirm: Cancel the import? Files already imported are kept, open ones are no longer taken over.

errors.generic: That did not work. Please try again.
errors.import_active: An import is already running or waiting in this club. Finish or cancel it first.
errors.zip_invalid: This is not a valid ZIP file.
errors.too_many_files: Too many files: at most {max} per import.
errors.too_many_bytes: Too large: at most {max_gb} GB per import.
errors.too_many_archives: Too many archives in one import.
errors.manifest_too_large: The file list is too large for one transfer.
errors.not_owner: Only the person who prepared the import can edit it.
errors.invalid_status: The import has changed in the meantime. Please reload the page.
errors.invalid_rules: At least one rule is invalid.
errors.nothing_to_import: With these rules no file will be imported.
errors.quota_exceeded: The club's storage quota is not sufficient. Reduce the selection or free up space and then resume the import.
errors.source_gone: The source is no longer available. Please start a new import.
errors.staging_busy: The server is still processing. The upload will continue shortly.
errors.wrong_source: This source does not match this import.
errors.invalid_paths: The upload's file list is invalid.
errors.expired: The import was discarded after 7 days without being started.
errors.requester_unauthorized: The import was stopped because the person who started it no longer has permission to do so.
errors.disk_full: The server is currently short of disk space. Please try again later.
errors.provider_unavailable: This cloud service is not available right now.
errors.reconnect_required: The connection to the cloud service has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.too_many_folders: Too many folders: at most {max} per import.
errors.selection_unavailable: The selected folders can no longer be reached at the cloud service.
errors.reauth_expired: The import was ended because nobody signed in again for 7 days.
errors.provider_error: The cloud service did not respond as expected.

rules.title: Rules
rules.intro: Rules are checked in order. Tags are combined, for the capture date the first matching rule applies, «Do not import» always wins.
rules.empty: Without rules all matching files are taken over unchanged.
rules.matches: {count, plural, =0 {matches no file} one {matches # file} other {matches # files}}
rules.pathGlobHelp: For example *.pdf, Photos/20??/* or **/Camp/**. * stands for any characters within one folder, ** for any number of folders.
rules.nameRegexHelp: For example ^IMG_\d+ or (?i)minutes. Back references and lookarounds are not supported.
rules.dateHelp: Only applies to images without a capture date in the file and appears as «estimated».
rules.skipHelp: Matching files are neither transferred nor imported.

errors.regex_unsupported: This expression is not supported (no back references or lookarounds).
errors.out_of_range: The date must be between 1826 and today.

rules.albumsOff: Album rules only apply when «Put images into albums by rule» is switched on.

preview.title: Preview
preview.kinds: {images, plural, one {# image} other {# images}}, {documents, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}}
preview.quotaExceeded: The import needs up to {planned}, only {free} is free. Reduce the selection with rules or free up space.
preview.ruleErrors: At least one rule is invalid - it is not applied in the preview and the import cannot start yet.
preview.conflictHint: Conflict: several rules set a different capture date. The first rule in the list applies.
preview.existingAlbums: These albums already exist and will be extended: {names}

codes.not_found: No longer at the cloud service
codes.access_denied: No access at the cloud service

start.label: Start import
start.confirm: Import {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} ({size})? The rules cannot be changed afterwards.

progress.title: Import running
progress.hint: You can leave this page. For a folder upload this window must stay open until all files are transferred.
progress.reselect: {count} files have not been transferred yet. Choose the same folder again to continue the upload.
progress.waitingForOwner: The import is waiting for files from the browser of the person who started it.

report.title: Report
report.cancelledCount: {count, plural, one {# no longer taken over} other {# no longer taken over}}
report.retention: The report is kept as long as at least one imported file exists.
report.albumReusedOldest: Album «{name}»: {count} albums with this name exist, the oldest was extended.

cloud.title: Connect to {provider}
cloud.privacy: You sign in directly with the provider. hocX only gets read access, only reads the folders you select and deletes the access as soon as the import has ended.
cloud.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect the cloud account? The access is deleted immediately.
cloud.chooseHint: Select the folders or files you want to bring over. A selected folder includes all subfolders.
cloud.selected: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing selected} one {# entry selected} other {# entries selected}}
cloud.listingHint: hocX is going through the selected folders at the cloud service. You can leave this page.
cloud.listingProgress: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} ({size}) found in {folders} folders.
cloud.throttled: The cloud service is slowing down requests. hocX waits and then continues automatically.
cloud.throttledUntil: The cloud service is slowing down requests. Continuing from {time}.
cloud.needsReauth: The cloud service requires you to sign in again (for example after a password change). The import then continues where it stopped.
cloud.needsReauthOther: The import is waiting for the person who started it to sign in to the cloud service again.

errors.empty_source: No files were found in the selection. Please choose other folders.
errors.selection_unavailable: The selected folders can no longer be reached. Please choose again.
errors.webdav_auth_failed: User name or app password is wrong.
errors.webdav_url_invalid: The address is invalid. Please check it.

adminConsent.title: Help: approval by the organisation’s IT
adminConsent.explain: Many work and school accounts only allow new apps once an administrator of the organisation has approved them. Personal accounts are not affected.
adminConsent.step1: Enter the organisation’s domain or tenant ID below and copy the approval link.
adminConsent.step2: Send the link to the IT. They open it, sign in as an administrator and grant the approval (read-only access).
adminConsent.tenantLabel: Domain or tenant ID of the organisation
adminConsent.tenantHelp: For example club.onmicrosoft.com, the organisation’s e-mail domain or the tenant ID.

connectHint.microsoft: Sign in with your Microsoft account (personal, work or school). hocX first only asks for read access to your own files; for “Shared with me” on work accounts and for SharePoint a second consent follows as soon as you open them.
connectHint.dropbox: Sign in to Dropbox. hocX only gets read access to files and folder details.
connectHint.webdav: Enter the credentials of your storage. Use an app password instead of your normal password; you can delete it at the provider after the import.
connectHint.google_drive: Sign in with Google. hocX will then only see the files you select in the Google picker in the next step, nothing else from your Drive.
connectHint.google_photos: Sign in with Google. You then pick the photos directly in Google Photos; hocX only sees that selection.

webdav.kdriveIdHelp: Only needed if you have several kDrives: the number in the kDrive address in your browser.
webdav.serverHelp: For example cloud.club.ch - without https:// and without a path.
webdav.urlHelp: Full address with https:// as given by your provider for WebDAV.
webdav.usernameHelp: For kDrive, the email address of your Infomaniak account.
webdav.passwordHelp: Stored encrypted and deleted as soon as the import has finished.
webdav.help: How to create an app password
webdav.reenterHint: The storage rejected the credentials (for example because the app password was deleted). Enter a valid app password; the import then continues.

google.driveHint: Open the Google picker and select the files you want to import (multiple selection possible, up to 200 per round).
google.driveFolders: Google cannot share whole folders this way. Create a Takeout export instead and import it as a ZIP archive.
google.photosHint: Google Photos opens in a new window. Select the photos there and tap “Done”. This page then continues automatically.
google.photosWaiting: Waiting for your selection in Google Photos …

googlePicker.title: Select files from Google Drive
googlePicker.intro: Select the files to import in the Google picker. hocX only gets access to these files.
googlePicker.cancelled: The picker was closed without selecting files.
